test_case.test_name: Parameterized rear USB-C alternate-mode display-path and visible-output validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the designated rear USB-C receptacle negotiates its approved display path and drives the approved monitor at the required stable mode with correct visible pixels and no Type-C/DRM errors.
required_package: xrandr/DRM sysfs access in the approved graphical session
Supported alternate-mode/role and approved cable/adapter/monitor EDID
Required resolution/refresh/color/orientation and known-pattern visual rubric
Approved connection/removal procedure and error limits
test_case.test_command: After operator connects the approved monitor fixture to the signed rear Type-C port, collect correctly quoted untruncated DRM connector status, EDID identity, xrandr providers/outputs/modes and Type-C/PD/DRM/kernel events. Operator displays the approved known pattern, records timestamped photos and stability/artifact/color/orientation observations, then disconnects safely.
test_case.expected_result: The bound rear port negotiates the approved path, exact monitor EDID appears on the mapped DRM connector at required mode, the known pattern remains visibly correct/stable, and no prohibited PD, reconnect, DRM or kernel event occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when physical path, fixture/EDID, negotiated mode, real visual rubric and signed error limits all match. Wrong port/path, missing/unstable display, artifact/color/orientation error or prohibited event is FAIL. Missing runtime binding/rubric is BLOCKED; connected/enumerated state alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact port/path, alternate mode, fixture, display criteria, hotplug procedure and recovery are signed.
Operator owns physical connection and visual observation; automation is read-only.
No mode change, driver install, log clearing, output truncation, connector guess or automatic retry.
Stop on PD fault, heat, reset/reconnect loop, unstable/lost image, artifacts or new DRM errors.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/GPU/driver identity
Signed rear-port logical path and alternate-mode behavior
Complete DRM/EDID/xrandr and Type-C/PD/DRM event output
Safe removal, preserved logs, discrepancy/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on signal or PD/DRM anomaly, preserve evidence and have the operator safely disconnect using the signed procedure. Restore the original display state without mode/driver/controller changes or automatic reconnect/retry.
